transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah. Nice to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm here because... I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't really shut the motor off, I guess. And... well, lately it's been getting me into some trouble at the firehouse. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you had a stretch of time when you felt unusually up or irritable compared with your normal self?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't think so. I'm just... kind of always like this.
Since you were a kid, have you often had trouble paying attention?

Yeah. I mean... probably. 

Like, even now... if we're in a briefing, or doing drone training or something, I'm locked in for the first few minutes. But then... I don't know. I'll just realize I've been staring at the map, or the screen, and... I didn't actually catch half of what command just said. So... yeah. I guess so.
Before age 12, did teachers or caregivers often tell you that you were easily distracted or had trouble staying focused?

Yeah, I guess so. My mom... she says I was like this back in grade school, too. Always getting out of my seat, blurting out answers... losing my homework. I got a lot of notes sent home, even though they said I was bright enough to do the work. So... yeah.
At work, do you often act or speak before thinking?

Um... yeah, sometimes. Like... if the guys are talking through a plan. I'll just... cut in. The answer is already in my head, so... I just say it. And then later I realize I stepped on somebody, or... kind of messed up the flow of the discussion. So... yeah. I do that.
Do these problems happen outside of work too?

Yeah. Even on my days off. 

My family... they try to do quiet stuff, like watch a movie or whatever. But... I can't really just sit there. I'll start talking, or... I don't know, I'll get up and go check on some tools in the garage. I just... I don't sit still for long.
Have these symptoms caused problems for you in more than one part of your life?

Yeah... I guess so. It's... it's definitely an issue at work. 

I don't really like getting into it, but... it's starting to cost me trust at the firehouse. They actually... they
Have you been through or witnessed something traumatic that still feels like it affects you?
Um... no. I mean... we see things on the job, obviously. But... no. I leave it at the station. It's not... it doesn't bother me like that.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to handle?
No. Not really. I don't... I'm not much of a worrier. If there's a problem, I just deal with it. So... no.
